# Module `bloburl`

The blob URL store (src/fetch/blob_urls.odin): what `URL.createObjectURL` makes, for everything that loads a URL outside the
realm that made it (an image, a stylesheet, a frame, a media element).

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: `api/bloburl.widl`.
